description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application to the latest supported Java runtime/framework baseline for modernization readiness.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested modernization to the latest framework.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the application runtime/framework baseline to the latest supported Java platform while preserving existing ledger business behavior and API compatibility where required.

tasks.description: Modernize application integrations to cloud-native Azure services.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested modernization toward cloud-native services.
tasks.requirements: Adopt cloud-native Azure service integration for configuration and secret management using managed identity and remove reliance on plaintext or environment-only secret handling patterns.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for known CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities before deployment.
tasks.reason: Security/CVE remediation is required in every modernization plan.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to patched versions, document major-version breaking-change risk when applicable, and verify build/test validation after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: The user requested deployment of the modernized application to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Containerize and deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps using managed Azure hosting and production-ready deployment configuration.
